text:
jordan_sales: FYI — FinCorp just asked for an executive-facing widget that correlates tenant billing spikes with latency traces. They want a one-click drilldown from a charge anomaly to the top 5 traces and the underlying model versions. Customer says it's a deal blocker for Q2 renewal.

alex_pm: Got it. Can you paste their email ask? Need to scope minimal MLP (must-land product) vs nice-to-have.

jordan_sales: Copy from customer: "We need: 1) per-tenant cost heatmap by model and endpoint, 2) clickable link from an anomaly to the trace list with model version + request sample, 3) CSV export for finance, 4) role-based visibility so only billing admins see dollar columns." They emphasized "clickable link" and CSV.

sam_eng_obs: Tech note: we already capture `trace_id` and model_version in traces, and billing events have tenant_id + timestamp. The main work is an index join and a UI that surfaces top-N traces for the anomaly window. On infra side: might need a short-lived analytics job or a fast precomputed join for 24h windows to keep latency <2s for drilldown.

mira_devex: UX needs: where does this live? Sandbox says a small dashboard tile on "Billing & Usage" page with a flyout that lists traces. CSV export can be same flyout. RBAC: reuse existing console permissions (billing_admin).

alex_pm: Proposal for scope negotiation: Phase 1 (ship-critical): per-tenant cost heatmap by model+endpoint, drilldown flyout showing top 10 trace summaries (trace_id, timestamp, latency, model_version, prompt snippet), CSV export of the flyout. RBAC using existing role. Phase 2 (follow-up): automated anomaly detection + one-click rerun/compare across model versions, precomputed joins for larger windows, SLA performance tuning.

jordan_sales: Customer will accept Phase 1 if delivered by end of month and visible in trial org. They want a demo for renewal.

sam_eng_obs: Rough estimates: Frontend tile + flyout: 3 dev-weeks. Backend join/API + CSV: 2 dev-weeks. Instrumentation + e2e: 1 dev-week. Ops: small infra for ad-hoc queries or a nightly job. Total ~6 dev-weeks with 1 engineer + 1 FE. Could drop CSV to save 1 week but customer explicitly asked for it.

alex_pm: Acceptance criteria (for product backlog): 1) Tile shows per-tenant cost heatmap (group by model endpoint + model_version dropdown), 2) Drilldown flyout shows top-10 traces for selected anomaly window, includes trace_id links that open tracing UI, 3) CSV export button in flyout with same columns, 4) Billing admins only see dollar columns, 5) Demo script and synthetic dataset for customer sandbox.

mira_devex: I'll draft the demo script and a sample dataset. Also will add docs snippet for how trace linking works (`/traces/<trace_id>`).

ops-bot: New ticket created: PROJ-4312 "FinCorp billing -> trace drilldown (Phase 1)" (priority: high).

jordan_sales: tagging @alex_pm @sam_eng_obs — please confirm we can commit to delivery window and I'll set expectation with FinCorp.

sam_eng_obs: I can own backend + infra, start Monday. Alex, can you pick FE owner?

alex_pm: I'll reach out to Priya (FE) and get a quick band-aid prototype ready for the demo. Marking this as p1 in roadmap board until we de-scope or commit.

jordan_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks team.

sam_eng_obs: One more thing — for trace samples we should redact PII before including prompt snippets in CSV. Add as acceptance criterion.

alex_pm: Good call. Updated ACs: add PII redaction step and privacy sign-off.

mira_devex: I'll include redaction note in demo dataset and docs.

jordan_sales: last ask from customer: can the CSV include line-item description per token cost? They can live without it if we can't do it quickly. Flagging as optional.

alex_pm: Optional feature noted (phase 1.5). We should log follow-up: per-token line items may need deeper billing schema changes.

ops-bot: PROJ-4312 assigned to sam_eng_obs, alex_pm, mira_devex. Due date tag: 2026-04-30.
